items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can book online using our contact form, call us directly, or walk in during clinic hours.

items.question: Do you accept insurance?
items.answer: Yes, we work with most major insurance providers. Please contact us to verify your specific plan.

items.question: What are your clinic hours?
items.answer: We are open Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Emergency services are available 24/7.

items.question: Are online consultations available?
items.answer: Yes! We offer telemedicine consultations for follow-ups and minor conditions. Ask us during booking.

content.heading: About Our Clinic
content.body: Founded in 2005, our multi-specialty clinic has been serving the community with compassionate, evidence-based medical care. We combine the latest medical technology with a patient-centered approach to deliver outcomes that matter. Our team of over 20 specialist doctors and 50 support staff work together to ensure every patient receives the best possible care in a comfortable, welcoming environment.
